description: Flutter client: make SupplyHub offline-first and lossless. Add persistent local Hive storage for inventory items (source of truth across restarts), persist every mutation locally before/independently of the network, replace the empty push catches with pending-sync tracking + non-blocking error surfacing, replace the destructive pull with a non-destructive merge by item_id that never drops offline-created items, fix the misleading comment, and keep the unit test compiling and passing. Independent of FEAT-001 in code; relies only on the stable HTTP contract that FEAT-001 keeps shape-stable (device_id still sent, ignored server-side).
steps: In lib/app_setup.dart add Hive.openBox<String>('supply_hub_items') to the openBoxes() Future.wait([...]) list (same style as the other boxes) and add Hive.deleteBoxFromDisk('supply_hub_items') to deleteBoxes().

In lib/features/supply_hub/application/inventory_notifier.dart mirror lib/service/local_filament_stock_service.dart: add 'static const String boxName = 'supply_hub_items'' and a _loadFromHive() guarded by 'if (Hive.isBoxOpen(boxName))' that reads box.values, decodes each via SupplyItem.fromJson(jsonDecode(...)) (reuse existing toJson/fromJson; NO Hive @HiveType adapter), and sets state; call it from the InventoryNotifier constructor. The no-arg InventoryNotifier() used by the test MUST still start empty (box not open under test).

Make every mutation persist locally: in addItem/incrementQuantity/decrementQuantity/toggleBoughtStatus/removeItem/removeItemWithCloud write the local box BEFORE/independently of the network call (await Hive.openBox<String>(boxName) then box.put(item.id, jsonEncode(item.toJson())) for upserts, box.delete(id) for removal). Guard all Hive access so it is a no-op when the box cannot be opened (test path).

Add per-item dirty/pending-sync tracking: keep a set of item ids pending push (persisted, e.g. a '__pending__' key in the box holding a JSON id list, or a dedicated structure). Replace the empty catch in _pushToCloud so that on push failure the data stays local and the touched ids are marked pending (retry on next sync) rather than silently swallowed; expose a non-blocking signal the UI can read (e.g. a pendingCount/syncError getter or a small state field).

Fix the misleading comment at inventory_notifier.dart ~line 124: it currently claims data is saved locally on push failure though no local storage existed; update it to accurately describe that the item is persisted in the local Hive box and marked pending for retry.

Replace pullFromCloud's 'state = cloudItems' with a non-destructive merge by item_id: union local and cloud by item_id; cloud is authoritative for already-synced shared ids; NEVER drop a local item that was created offline and never successfully pushed (local-pending wins and is then re-pushed). After a successful merge, persist the merged list to the box, then attempt to push still-pending items. Document the merge rule in a comment.

Keep the red SnackBar on pull failure in presentation/screens/supply_hub_page.dart and keep local data intact when offline (a pull failure must not clear the box/state). Optionally surface pendingCount non-blockingly in the page.

Keep test/features/supply_hub/inventory_notifier_test.dart compiling and passing: it constructs InventoryNotifier() with no args and expects empty start + synchronous in-memory mutations. If the constructor signature changes (prefer it does not), update the test. Optionally add Hive.init-to-temp-dir tests in setUp for load-on-construct and write-on-mutation, guarded so they do not break when no temp dir is available.
Do NOT run build_runner (no freezed/json annotation changes). Reuse SupplyItem.toJson/fromJson.
acceptance_criteria: Inventory items persist in Hive box 'supply_hub_items' and survive an app restart; the box is opened in openBoxes() and removed in deleteBoxes().
The InventoryNotifier loads local items on construction (not empty) when the box is open, and still starts empty under the unit test (box not open).
Every mutation writes the local box; a push failure keeps the data locally, marks items pending, and does not throw to the UI (no empty catch swallowing data loss).
pullFromCloud merges by item_id and never drops a local item that was created offline and not yet pushed; the merged list is persisted locally.
A pull failure still shows the red SnackBar and leaves local data intact (offline works).
The misleading comment at ~line 124 is corrected.
flutter test test/features/supply_hub/inventory_notifier_test.dart passes and flutter analyze lib/features/supply_hub reports no issues for these files.
No Hive @HiveType adapter is added and build_runner is not run.
verification: From repo root: flutter analyze lib/features/supply_hub (expect no issues for these files; the pre-existing global custom_lint/riverpod_lint plugin-load error is unrelated).
From repo root: flutter test test/features/supply_hub/inventory_notifier_test.dart (all tests pass).

Code review against the pattern in lib/service/local_filament_stock_service.dart: boxName constant, _loadFromHive guarded by Hive.isBoxOpen in the constructor, writes on every mutation, non-destructive merge in pullFromCloud.
findings: IMPLEMENTED offline-first SupplyHub. Files changed: lib/app_setup.dart (added Hive.openBox<String>('supply_hub_items') to openBoxes() Future.wait and Hive.deleteBoxFromDisk('supply_hub_items') to deleteBoxes()); lib/features/supply_hub/application/inventory_notifier.dart (full offline-first rewrite). The InventoryNotifier now has 'static const String boxName = 'supply_hub_items'' and a _loadFromHive() called from the constructor, guarded by 'if (!Hive.isBoxOpen(boxName)) return;' — so the no-arg InventoryNotifier() used by the unit test still starts empty (box not open under test). Reuses SupplyItem.toJson/fromJson via jsonEncode/jsonDecode; NO Hive @HiveType adapter added and build_runner NOT run. IMPORTANT Hive-under-test detail: calling Hive.openBox() when Hive is NOT initialized throws a HiveError that is reported to the test error zone and is NOT caught by a surrounding try/catch (zone-level async error). Therefore ALL Hive access is gated strictly through a synchronous 'Box<String>? _box()' helper that returns null unless Hive.isBoxOpen(boxName) is true; we never call Hive.openBox() in the notifier. In production the box is opened at startup by openBoxes(), so _box() returns the live box; in tests it returns null and every persistence call is a safe no-op. PENDING-SYNC tracking: an in-memory 'Set<String> _pendingSync' persisted under the reserved box key '__pending__' as a JSON id list (loaded in _loadFromHive, written via _persistPending()). _pushToCloud(List<String> touchedIds) replaced the empty catch: on success it clears _pendingSync + _syncError; on failure the local data stays, touched ids are added to _pendingSync, _syncError is set to e.toString(), and NOTHING is rethrown to the UI. Non-blocking signals exposed: 'int get pendingCount' and 'String? get syncError'. Every mutation persists locally: addItem/incrementQuantity/decrementQuantity/toggleBoughtStatus call _persistItem (upsert via box.put(id, jsonEncode(item.toJson()))) then _pushToCloud; removeItem and removeItemWithCloud call _deleteItem (box.delete(id)) + _persistPending then push/delete to cloud. The misleading comment at ~line 124 was replaced (now accurately: data persisted in the local Hive box and marked pending for retry; no silent swallow). pullFromCloud NO LONGER does 'state = cloudItems'; it does a NON-DESTRUCTIVE merge by item_id: start from all cloud items (cloud authoritative for already-synced ids), then overlay any local item whose id is in _pendingSync (offline-created/edited items win and are NEVER dropped), set state, persist the merged list via _persistAll (which also prunes stale item keys but preserves '__pending__'), then re-push still-pending items. supply_hub_page.dart was intentionally left unchanged: it already shows the red SnackBar on pull failure and leaves local state intact (pullFromCloud only reassigns state AFTER a successful api.pullItems(); a network throw propagates to _syncFromCloud's catch without clearing state/box). Surfacing pendingCount in the page is optional per the spec and was skipped to keep the diff minimal. supply_api_service.dart and supply_item.dart were NOT modified (HTTP contract shape stable; device_id still sent and ignored server-side per FEAT-001).
